integrity: Symbolic matrix identities and representative orbit calculations were executed; proof uses a proper positive relative entropy, a rank-three kernel, invariant level uniqueness and local transverse dissipation. No independent verification or exhaustive historical-priority determination has been performed.
limitations: The all-positive global convergence and exponential-selection theorem holds for \(1<a<\rho\) only, on the singular participation curve; at \(a=\rho\) only matrix semidefiniteness is proved, and for \(a>\rho\) failure of a diagonal certificate does not imply dynamical instability. Boundary initial data and nearby participation weights are excluded.
title: Global selection on the singular four-species cycle and its sharp entropy window
